text: Prayer is not asking. It is a longing of the soul.
author: Mahatma Gandhi

archive.text: The philosophers have only interpreted the world, in various ways. The point, however, is to change it.
archive.author: Karl Marx

archive.text: If I am not for myself, who will be for me? If I am not for others, what am I? And if not now, when?
archive.author: Rabbi Hillel

archive.text: If you want to shine like a sun, first burn like a sun.
archive.author: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam

archive.text: Keep silence for the most part, and speak only when you must, and then briefly.
archive.author: Epictetus

archive.text: Walking with a friend in the dark is better than walking alone in the light.
archive.author: Helen Keller

archive.text: Before you can inspire with emotion, you must be swamped with it yourself. Before you can move their tears, your own must flow. To convince them, you must yourself believe.
archive.author: Winston Churchill
